title: UE Performance Regression
description: Run repeatable performance samples, compare compatible results, and escalate failures to trace evidence.

recipes.title: Compare repeatable baseline and candidate runs
recipes.description: Capture two runs under a fixed environment, compare explicit thresholds, and collect trace evidence only on demand.

inputs.name: changeDescription
inputs.description: The one intended code, asset, or configuration change allowed to differ between baseline and candidate.

inputs.name: baselineRunId
inputs.description: Existing succeeded baseline run. When absent, capture a baseline before the caller performs the intended change.

inputs.name: warmupSeconds
inputs.description: Warmup time used identically by both runs.

inputs.name: sampleSeconds
inputs.description: Measurement window used identically by both runs.

inputs.name: repeatCount
inputs.description: Repeat count used identically by both runs.

inputs.name: checks
inputs.description: Explicit metric, statistic, regression, and budget checks.

inputs.name: captureTrace
inputs.description: Pre-capture a trace during each performance run. Failure escalation still replays the candidate under trace when no useful trace exists.

steps.purpose: Record render environment, PIE state, and memory context before sampling.
Use an existing baseline or capture it before the caller's intended change, then run the candidate with identical settings and poll every durable job.
Compare explicit thresholds only when both runs succeeded and their fingerprints match.
Read both terminal performance runs and retain their bounded metric and fingerprint evidence.
Detect explicit or suspected frame limiting before CPU/GPU attribution and generate HTML, JSON, and JUnit evidence with log health, CPU/GPU trace evidence, next steps, and safe artifact references.
When comparison regresses or the caller requests attribution, start trace, replay the same candidate workload, stop trace even after replay failure, analyze, and poll the analysis job.

result.summary: Compatible before/after performance verdict with percentile and threshold evidence.
evidence: sample counts and p50, p95, p99 metrics
trace, analysis job, and artifact IDs when captured
run-bounded log health, Top CPU scopes, GPU intervals, and next steps
safe opaque artifact references for production.job.artifact.get
success: both runs reached a succeeded terminal state
only the declared intended change differed and measured environment fingerprints matched
the verdict was produced by explicit compare checks
a requested or regression-triggered trace replay was stopped and its analysis reached a terminal state
incompatible evidence was reported as inconclusive
stable 60 Hz cadence without an explicit limiter was reported as suspected and inconclusive
